id_requirements: Two forms of ID are required. Primary ID must be government-issued, include candidate's name, photo, and signature (e.g. passport, driver's license). Secondary ID must include candidate's name and signature or name and photo.
exam_rules: No notes, scratch paper, electronic devices, books, or study materials permitted. Personal items must be stored. No food or drink except water. Restroom breaks allowed but timer continues. Testing center staff may monitor via video/audio.
renewal_options: Earn CE credits through CompTIA CE program (training, conferences, publishing, teaching, higher certs) or retake the current exam version before expiry.

retake_policy.notes: No waiting period required before first retake. After the second failed attempt, candidates must wait 14 calendar days before any subsequent attempt. No limit on total attempts.

editorial.meta_description: CompTIA Data+ DA0-001 is retired. Candidates should pursue the DA0-002 CompTIA Data+ (V2) certification to validate their data analysis and management skills
editorial.overview: CompTIA Data+ (DA0-001) is a certification administered by CompTIA covering data concepts and environments, data mining, data analysis, visualization, and data governance, quality, and controls. This exam is retired as of 2026-07-16. Candidates seeking certification must prepare for DA0-002 (CompTIA Data+ (V2)) instead, which serves as the direct replacement path for this retired credential. The retired exam is no longer available for testing.
editorial.who_should_take: This retired exam targeted professionals seeking to validate data management, mining, analysis, and governance competencies. Candidates should now focus their efforts on the successor credential, DA0-002 (CompTIA Data+ (V2)), to demonstrate their professional expertise.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Because DA0-001 is retired, candidates must consult official CompTIA resources for the DA0-002 (CompTIA Data+ (V2)) exam. Study plans should focus on understanding data environments, mining techniques, analytical methods, visualization practices, and governance frameworks. Reviewing the updated objectives for the successor exam ensures all required competencies are addressed, as the retired DA0-001 materials are no longer applicable for current certification requirements.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers data concepts and environments, accounting for 15.0 percent of the exam weight. It establishes core principles for understanding data structures, repositories, and environment types utilized across modern organizational data architectures for candidates.

This domain focuses on data mining, representing 25.0 percent of the exam. It addresses methods for extracting and acquiring data from various sources to prepare datasets for subsequent analytical tasks and reporting workflows for professionals.

This domain encompasses data analysis, holding a weight of 23.0 percent. It covers applying statistical and analytical methods to interpret datasets, evaluate outcomes, and identify primary trends or operational anomalies for the certification candidates.

This domain covers visualization, accounting for 23.0 percent of the exam. It evaluates the ability to design clear charts, reports, and dashboards that communicate analytical findings effectively to various business stakeholders within an organization.

This domain focuses on data governance, quality, and controls, making up 14.0 percent of the exam. It details policies, security practices, and maintenance procedures required to ensure continuous data integrity throughout the entire data lifecycle.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Because DA0-001 is retired as of 2026-07-16, it can no longer be scheduled or taken at a testing center. Candidates must register for and take the successor exam, DA0-002 (CompTIA Data+ (V2)), to earn their certification.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The retired DA0-001 exam consisted of 90 questions. Candidates interested in this certification path should now register for the DA0-002 (CompTIA Data+ (V2)) exam, which is the current official replacement for this retired credential.

The retired DA0-001 exam required a passing score of 675 on a scale of 100-900. Candidates should no longer prepare for this retired test and should instead register for the DA0-002 (CompTIA Data+ (V2)) exam.

The retired DA0-001 exam had a duration of 90 minutes. This exam is no longer available for scheduling. Candidates must now register for the DA0-002 (CompTIA Data+ (V2)) exam to pursue their certification goals.

The retired DA0-001 exam was priced at 369.0 USD. As this exam is retired, candidates should not attempt to schedule it and must instead register for the DA0-002 (CompTIA Data+ (V2)) replacement exam.
